# Template-variable parity

Which root template variables each cloud declares, for every variable that is **not** on all
of them. Derived from the templates themselves; the reasons come from
`infra/template-parity-exclusions.yaml`.

This is the surface the offer-parity and config-carriage guards cannot see: both build their
view from the canvas, so a capability that is only a template variable is invisible to them.
